notes: APVIS Browser: a private web browser in APVIS style with tracker blocking, third-party cookies refused, DuckDuckGo search and Ask APVIS about any page (Ctrl+Shift+A). Open it from Apps, the Apps Store, or say "open bbc.co.uk" / "search the web for..." in Ask. The browser itself needs the dev.26 image (Qt WebEngine); on older images Home tells you so.
